records.academicNote: An honours bachelor or assessed equivalent is required; no honours class or exclusive major is stated. Submit a 500-word English interest letter, a work portfolio (such as publications, demonstrations, GitHub or websites) and two reference letters. Shortlisted applicants may be interviewed. IELTS 6.0, old TOEFL 74 or CET-6 450 is published. A PGD exit and its CGPA 2.5 are not a separate master or undergraduate admission GPA.

A recognised bachelor or assessed equivalent is accepted; final-year applicants may apply. Business and non-business entrants must satisfy pre-core competencies. Required pre-core courses add HKD 5,000 EACH, with the number assessed individually. Applicants should confirm their degree recognition for HKICPA QP; programme admission does not guarantee professional registration. IELTS 6.0, old TOEFL 79 or CET-6 450 is published.

An Economics background is desirable, not a prerequisite. Applicants from other disciplines may qualify with preparation in microeconomics, macroeconomics, calculus, linear algebra and statistics. This preparation requires transcript assessment rather than an Economics-only major gate. IELTS 6.0, old TOEFL 79 or CET-6 450 is published.

This is the two-year full-time Putonghua MBA with weekend classes in Hong Kong, not an English MBA borrowed from another university. Bachelor/equivalent professional qualification plus three full-time post-qualification work years; Benke plus six years; or exceptional other Ministry-of-Education-recognised tertiary qualification plus eight full-time managerial/professional post-qualification years. The automatic three-year necessary lower bound does not establish the correct six/eight-year branch or work type/timing. Satisfactory interactive group interview performance is mandatory. No programme-specific English test threshold is established in the consulted body; applicability of the general English requirement remains unconfirmed.

Bachelor/equivalent professional qualification is one route with no fixed work-year minimum stated. An alternative diploma route requires four work years; those years are NOT a universal bachelor-applicant requirement. IELTS 6.5 or old TOEFL 79 is published; shortlisted applicants are interviewed. Scholarship honours/work criteria are not universal admission gates.

Any bachelor discipline may be considered. Non-STEM applicants need quantitative coursework plus intermediate IT/IS or business knowledge evidenced through study/work. Work experience is preferred, not compulsory. Two academic/professional references are required and shortlisted applicants attend a panel interview. IELTS 6.0, old TOEFL 79 or CET-6 450 is published. English validity is described relative to commencement of the University application period; which opening is the applicable anchor needs confirmation.

Honours BSc Chemistry or a physical/life-science field with strong analytical-measurement emphasis, or assessed equivalent. Other qualifications with substantial relevant experience may be considered exceptionally; no fixed number of work years is inferred. The normal language route is IELTS 6.5, old TOEFL 79, CET-6 450 or accepted English-medium evidence. IELTS 6.0 or equivalent MAY be considered with required English enhancement if admitted. The automated IELTS 6.0 is only a necessary considered-score lower bound, not unconditional satisfaction of the normal 6.5 route. No lower TOEFL enhancement score is published. Interim PGD/GPA 2.5 is not a new master or entry GPA.

Business honours bachelor or equivalent professional accounting/finance qualification; alternatively another bachelor with relevant experience/training. A non-business bachelor without that preparation may still be considered with an assigned intensive fundamentals course (extra cost) or guided self-study. These are alternatives, not a business-only or universal work-year gate. GMAT and work experience are preferred, not fixed compulsory scores/years. Interview is required. IELTS 6.0, old TOEFL 79 or CET-6 450 is published. Conditional HKICPA/ACCA two-course exemption/fee waiver is not deducted from the standard total.

Bachelor/equivalent professional qualification may be accepted. Three relevant work years are PREFERRED, not mandatory. IELTS 6.0, old TOEFL 79 or assessed equivalent is published. Professional examination-exemption eligibility is not automatic professional registration. Full-time HKD 270,000 and part-time HKD 255,000 are MODE totals, not local/non-local prices. The stated application opening is 4 January 2027; COMING does not establish present availability.

Science, Engineering, Information Technology or a relevant bachelor/equivalent is the normal academic route. Other qualifications with substantial IT experience may be assessed exceptionally. IELTS 6.0 or old TOEFL 74/equivalent is published; no fixed work-year gate is inferred. The 29-unit load and scholarship GPA 3.9/3.7/3.4 after entry are not undergraduate admission GPA thresholds.

Business and non-business bachelor degrees with good quantitative training may qualify. Quantitative preparation and academic quality need assessment; no Economics-only gate or numeric GPA is invented. IELTS 6.0, old TOEFL 79 or CET-6 450 is published.

Any-discipline bachelor/equivalent or at least 180 ECTS may be considered. IELTS 6.5 with EVERY component at least 6.0, or old TOEFL 90 with EVERY section at least 21. CPE A/B/C and PTE 63 are manual alternatives. GMAT and French are not required. Two references, CV, personal statement, qualification/transcript/identity and accepted language evidence are needed. The central page explicitly labels January 2028 entry and HKD 298,000 for the 15-month single HKBU MSc. Grenoble double degree is OPTIONAL; opting into it entails study in France and is not represented as an ordinary HK-only route. Central final date 30 November 2026 conflicts with department early/first/second/late deadlines ending 24 July 2027 without an unambiguous matching cohort. No actionable final date is selected. PGD/masters graduation GPA 2.5 is not entry GPA.

Bachelor/equivalent is one route. Higher diploma plus five relevant post-graduation work years, or another approved qualification, is an alternative; five years is NOT imposed on all bachelor applicants. Normal language route IELTS 6.5/old TOEFL 79/CET-6 450 or accepted English-medium evidence. IELTS 6.0 or old TOEFL 74 MAY be considered with English enhancement if admitted; the lower scores do not establish unconditional normal-route satisfaction. All applicants must perform satisfactorily in an English admission interview.

Honours bachelor/equivalent professional qualification is required; no honours class is invented. Basic Finance, Mathematics or Computer Science training may come from a major, minor, courses or work, OR assigned preparatory courses must be passed before formal admission. This is not an exclusive undergraduate-major gate. GMAT/GRE is encouraged, not required. Three relevant work years for part-time applicants is a preference that may be relaxed, not a compulsory universal minimum. Interview is required. IELTS 6.0, old TOEFL 79 or CET-6 450 is published.

Bachelor/equivalent tertiary professional qualification; Science or Engineering is PREFERRED, not an exclusive major. Relevant work is advantageous but not essential. IELTS 6.0, old TOEFL 74 or CET-6 450 is stated for non-local non-English-medium applicants. Applicability to local applicants and English-medium evidence remains assessed; no automatic local exemption is inferred.

Science, Engineering, Business or a relevant bachelor/equivalent is the normal route. Other qualifications with substantial IT experience may be considered exceptionally. IELTS 6.0 or old TOEFL 74/equivalent is published. No fixed work-year minimum is inferred. The 29-unit curriculum and post-entry scholarship GPA do not establish undergraduate entry GPA.

Bachelor/equivalent in any discipline; the business/creative target audience is not an exclusive major gate. IELTS 6.5 or old TOEFL 79/accepted English-medium evidence is published. Shortlisted applicants are interviewed. The curriculum expressly includes a REQUIRED three-unit overseas field trip. Cancellation/rescheduling/downsizing alternatives are mentioned, but no elective personal opt-out or 2027 destination within Hong Kong/Singapore is established. Delivery scope remains unconfirmed. Travel costs are extra; subsidy UP TO HKD 10,000 is neither guaranteed nor deducted from tuition.

Maths, Statistics, Computer Science, Physics, Engineering, Business or related bachelor/equivalent and basic Mathematics proficiency; a test may be required. IELTS overall 6.0 AND (Reading at least 6.5 OR Listening at least 6.5), or old TOEFL 79/accepted English-medium equivalent. The OR component condition is a separate mandatory manual check: do not require both components or mark the whole language requirement met from overall alone.

Maths, Statistics, Computer Science, Physics, Engineering, Business or related bachelor/equivalent with basic Mathematics proficiency; a test may be required. IELTS overall 6.0 AND (Reading at least 6.5 OR Listening at least 6.5), or old TOEFL 79/accepted English-medium equivalent. The OR component condition remains a mandatory manual check. Joint HKBU/Kent operation and two awards do NOT establish required UK attendance or create two catalogue parents. Current 2027 delivery/partner arrangements need confirmation. The 40-unit load, not an older handbook credit count, is retained.

Business bachelor/equivalent professional qualification is one route. Non-business bachelor applicants may qualify with required online preparatory modules AND a one-day pre-term bootcamp, rather than being excluded by major. IELTS 6.0, old TOEFL 79 or CET-6 470 is published (not CET-6 450). Interview is required; no fixed work-year threshold or invented preparatory-course charge is added.
